g.text: Annual spending on the student's education (rupees, log scale)
The middle 80% of rural Balochistan's students cost their families
between Rs 600 and Rs 18,700 a year
Source: PSLM 2019-20, person file merged with household file. Sample: 1,464 students (ed_total > 0), rural Balochistan.
1 student(s) outside Rs 100 - Rs 1,000,000 excluded from the histogram.
Weighted by hhweight; bins 0.1 wide in log10 units.
